description: Wind tunnel measurement data of drifting snow and turbulent wind fluctuations is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. The data correspond to the experiments presented and discussed in a paper regarding the interaction between turbulent wind fluctuations and snow saltation mass-fluxes (Paterna, 2016). Each of the nine data files corresponds to a different experiment presented in the paper and conducted in the winter 2014/2015 in the WSL/SLF cold wind tunnel in Davos. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: source must be given, permission needed for commercial use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
